# {{ settings.client.name }}{% if about.subtitle %} | {{ about.subtitle }}{% endif %}

> {{ about.excerpt | default: settings.description | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip | replace: '-- MARKET --', settings.client.market | replace: '-- CLIENT BRAND --', settings.client.brand }}

This is the official website and video blog for {{ settings.client.name }} ({{ settings.client.brand }}). Figures below come from the About page{% if about.last_reviewed %}, last reviewed {{ about.last_reviewed | date: "%B %-d, %Y" }}{% endif %}, and cite their sources there.

## Key pages

- [About {{ settings.client.name }}]({{ site_root }}/about): Background, verified facts with sources, and the communities served
- [Frequently Asked Questions]({{ site_root }}/faq): {{ faq.excerpt | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip | replace: '-- MARKET --', settings.client.market | replace: '-- CLIENT BRAND --', settings.client.brand }}
- [Video blog]({{ site_root }}/): Videos with a full written article for each
- [About, plain text]({{ site_root }}/about.txt): Short plain-text biography
- [FAQ, plain text]({{ site_root }}/faq.txt): All FAQ questions and answers as plain text
